notes: Play knowledge rewritten as executable actions. Every tag, objective and node reference is checked against the generated level data by tools/gen_level_nuance.py.

nuance.claim: Nothing else in the level is reachable until entry to the laboratory area is gained, so it is always first.
nuance.because: Objective 0 is the entry gate and the remaining objectives all sit past it.

nuance.claim: Contacting the double agent is not required on Agent; on Secret Agent and above it must be done before the meeting with 006.
nuance.because: Objective 1 carries a minimum difficulty above Agent, and the 006 rendezvous ends the lab section.

nuance.claim: The double agent does not spawn in a fixed place; he is a scientist-looking figure carrying an item and appears in one of several rooms, so he has to be searched for rather than routed to.
The double agent is dressed as a scientist, so blind fire at scientists can destroy an objective and the casualty objective at once.
The rendezvous with 006 happens in the bottling room at the end of the lab run, so anything wanted from earlier rooms must be collected before going there.
The bottling room tanks are destroyed with remote mines spaced so each blast catches more than one tank, rather than one charge per tank.
The casualty objective is usually lost to crossfire rather than deliberate shots; scientists share the hallways with the guards being fought.
The restroom holds a cluster of soldiers who engage together; one can be picked off from the vent above before entering.
The security door needs a keycard carried by a soldier, so a guard has to be killed and looted before the route continues.
On higher difficulties the bottling room door needs the door decoder, so the decoder must be in hand before the tank objective is attempted.
